title: Dispositional mindfulness attenuates the emotional attentional blink
authors: Makowski, D., Sperduti, M., Lavallée, S., Nicolas, S., & Piolino, P.
summary: In the emotional attentional blink, an emotionally charged distractor makes the next target hard to see at all. People higher in dispositional mindfulness showed a smaller blink, suggesting trait mindfulness buffers the attentional cost of emotional distraction.
